resources.string:
Use only while safely parked with the vehicle ON. Keep hands and objects clear of all windows.

This turns climate OFF, closes all four windows, sets headlights OFF (including AUTO), turns DRLs OFF, mutes media, then sends the car's Screen off shortcut command.

Touch the screen to wake it and automatically disable Camping Mode, restoring the saved climate, media volume, headlight selection and DRLs; windows stay closed. Call, alarm and safety audio are not targeted. This does not keep the vehicle powered or monitor occupants.
Park with the vehicle ON before enabling. Wake the screen to automatically restore saved settings; windows stay closed.
Updating settings. Please wait. STOP WINDOWS remains available.
Camping Mode active. Touch the screen to wake it and automatically restore saved settings.
Saved settings need restoration. Check results below and tap Retry restoring settings. Saved settings are kept until restoration succeeds.
